kpis.label: Deals screened per professional
kpis.baseline: Count the deals screened last month, and divide by the people who screened them.

kpis.label: Days to decide on a deal
kpis.effect_phrase: cut the days to decide on a deal
kpis.baseline: Take your last ten deals, and record the days from first look to the pass or proceed decision.

kpis.label: Diligence cycle time
kpis.baseline: Take your last three deals, and record the days from data room access to diligence complete.

kpis.label: LP reporting cycle time
kpis.baseline: Record the days from the last quarter end to the final LP report going out.

kpis.label: Days to answer LP requests and DDQs
kpis.effect_phrase: cut the days to answer LP requests and DDQs
kpis.baseline: Take the last ten LP requests, and record the days from receipt to reply.

kpis.label: Time to refresh fundraising materials
kpis.effect_phrase: shorten the time to refresh fundraising materials
kpis.baseline: Record the days your last refresh of the deck and track record took.

kpis.label: Days to receive company data after period end
kpis.effect_phrase: cut the days to receive company data after period end
kpis.baseline: Record the day each company's data arrived after the last period end.

kpis.label: Days after period end to spot a problem
kpis.effect_phrase: cut the days after period end to spot a problem
kpis.baseline: Take the last three problems you found, and record how long after the period end you saw each.

kpis.label: Initiatives with an owner, a date, and a KPI
kpis.effect_phrase: raise the share of initiatives with an owner, a date, and a KPI
kpis.baseline: Count initiatives, and the share with a named owner, a date, and a measurable KPI today.
kpis.feeds: evidence of value creation for LPs

kpis.label: Days to assemble exit data
kpis.effect_phrase: cut the days to assemble exit data
kpis.baseline: For your next planned exit, list the data still missing and how long you expect it to take.

kpis.label: Partner hours a month on routine work
kpis.effect_phrase: cut partner hours on routine work
kpis.baseline: Ask each partner for a rough count of hours last month on the assessed work.

kpis.label: Quarter-end close time
kpis.baseline: Record the working days your last quarter-end close took.

kpis.label: Operating cost as a share of fees
kpis.effect_phrase: lower operating cost as a share of fees
kpis.baseline: Take the management company's operating cost last year, and divide it by management fees.
kpis.feeds: the firm's own economics, not fund returns

kpis.label: Errors in reports and filings
kpis.effect_phrase: reduce errors in reports and filings
kpis.baseline: Count corrections after issue, across reports and filings, in the last four quarters.
